## Checklist

- [ ] `make check` passes (gofmt, vet, tests)
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] If a config option changed: `internal/config/default.toml`, `config.example.toml` (`make sync-config`) and `docs/CONFIGURATION.md` are updated
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under *Unreleased*
- [ ] No third-party dependencies were added
